canonical_project: Equinix KL1 Kuala Lumpur / Cyberjaya IBX
notes: Equinix's official KL1 page places KL1 in Cyberjaya under its Kuala Lumpur data center market, with the facility operating by 2024 according to Equinix newsroom. Data Center Map reports 4.8 MW. Note: Cyberjaya is in Selangor/Greater Kuala Lumpur rather than physically inside the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur.
